prompt_data.main_prompt: A dark romantic gothic T-shirt design featuring a mysterious, ornate floral pattern with dramatic lines and deep black, purple, and silver color palette. The composition includes a central focal point surrounded by negative space, creating an elegant and captivating image that would be perfect for print-on-demand production.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid overly busy designs, poor resolution, low-quality typography, and excessive use of bright colors or cartoonish elements. Focus on maintaining a high-quality gothic aesthetic with a balance of ornate and mysterious design elements.
